a.lede: OpenAI isn't a public supporter of Nvidia's Open Agent Safety Platform, but it is privately working with Nvidia, TechCrunch has learned.
a.title: Here’s why OpenAI is absent from Nvidia’s industry-wide effort to end rogue AI agents

b.lede: Nvidia’s new Open Agent Safety Platform combines OpenShell sandboxing with BlueField-powered Sentry hardware to monitor and rapidly quarantine rogue AI agents
b.title: Nvidia launches Open Agent Safety Platform to physically restrain rogue AI agents
